condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

Component 1 1.1 Number of target communities for development of CDPs identified in Karakalpakstan, Khorezm, Bukhara and Navoi regions - 170 Jointly with Project Management Unit under Ministry of Economic Development and Poverty Reduction has identified 120 communities for 2021 – 2022 years and a preliminary list of 50 communities for 2023 year, which will be finalized in 1st quarter of 2023 year.
In order to verify and identify communities there were organized several meetings with PMU ministries and regional partners as well as field visits to the pilot regions.
1.2 Number of community members and representatives of local authorities trained on CDP process and community needs assessment, disaggregated by gender, , as well as on improving rural economy, such as knowledge sharing on agriculture & new farming methodologies, irrigation technologies, and strengthening home industries related to women empowerment. - 3126 In total 78 community mobilization, community needs and CDP development workshops by covering 3,126 local mahalla residents (1514 women, 1612 men and 278 youth) were reached in 78 communities in the 4 pilot regions The breakdown by regions, the community mobilization workshops were attended by: - from Khorezm region 21 community mobilization workshops - 842 residents, including 343 women, 499 men and 26 youth; - from Navoi region 15 community mobilization - 603 residents, including 189 women, 414 men and 72 youth; - from Bukhara region 23 community mobilization workshops - 960 inhabitants, including 343 women, 617 men and 74 youth; - from the Republic of Karakalpakstan 19 community mobilization workshops - 721 residents, including 325 women, 396 men and 106 youth.
1.3 Number of CDPs developed and implemented - 120 In total, 42 CDPs in 2021 and 78 CDPs in 2022 developed. Among these 78 CDPs integrated into 18 Cluster CDPs for 2022 year and 42 CDPs integrated into 10 Cluster CDPs for 2021 year. Preliminary versions of the CDPs were presented to representatives of local authorities and members of initiative groups for feedback. Furthermore, in January and February 2023, national consultants (engineers) on infrastructure development will be engaged to finalize the technical part of the CDPs developed
Component 2 2.2 Number of beneficiaries of trainings on energy efficient construction materials and low carbon technology, economic and agriculture infrastructure, men/women breakdown - 0 The TOR for the national consulting company on conducting capacity assessment of local architectural planning environment (e.g., regulations, technical capacities of architects/engineers) with regard to adopting and implementing climate resilient solution has been developed.
Component 3 3.1 Status of the assessment report of local capacities to implement government digitalization agenda - N/A Terms of reference have been prepared to conduct a study about digital readiness of pilot regions in the field of introducing digital services and digital transformation, innovative IT solutions, including the development of digital infrastructure and information systems to expand access to social facilities and services in rural areas. It is planned to attract a consulting company for the evaluation.
Component 4 4.4 Number of PR/Outreach events promoting the project results and raising awareness among communities - 5 In this reporting period there were conducted following project events: 1. There was conducted 3-days ToT training on community mobilization and CDP development for 12 local facilitators in Tashkent on September 7-9, 2022. The training was attended by 26 participants, including 12 facilitators - national consultants on community mobilization, representatives of the Department of Economy and Poverty Reduction, local Khokimiyats, mahallas of Karakalpakstan, Khorezm, Bukhara and Navoi regions. 2. Community mobilization & CDP development trainings for 78 communities were conducted in two stages: • Stage 1: According to approved list and 66 seminars were conducted in 4 pilot regions. • Stage 2: 12 additional seminars were conducted in 4 pilot regions. 3. The official opening of the project took place on October 18, with more than 100 participants, including representatives of national ministries, agencies, institutions, local authorities of Karakalpakstan, Khorezm, Bukhara and Navoi regions, IsDB, OPEC, UNDP, IFIs and Development Partners, NGOs, representatives of academic and research institutions and the media. The meeting was opened by Mr. Jamshid Kuchkarov, Deputy Prime Minister of the Republic of Uzbekistan/Minister of Economic Development and Poverty Reduction, Mr. Ibrahim Ali Shoukry, Regional Head, Regional Hub Almaty IsDB and Ms. Matilda Dimovska, UNDP Resident Representative in Uzbekistan. 4. First Project Board Meeting held on December 19, 2022, by attending the representatives of national ministries, agencies, institutions and local authorities of Karakalpakstan, Khorezm, Bukhara and Navoi regions, IsDB, UNDP, IFIs and Development Partners. There were discussed results of 2022 year, lessons learnt and project plans for 2023 year. 5. Several working meetings of IsDB, Ministry of Economy, UNDP and facilitators.
4.5 Number of publications/articles issued and disseminated widely among partners and mass media - 15 UNDP together with the Ministry of Economic Development and Poverty Reduction, the Islamic Development Bank (IDB), and the OPEC Fund for International Development started a new project to promote Sustainable Rural Development.
